title: Press a keyboard key
summary: Keyboard actions help check access beyond mouse clicks. Tab normally moves focus to the next control.
introduction: Keyboard actions help check access beyond mouse clicks. Tab normally moves focus to the next control. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Keyboard actions help check access beyond mouse clicks. Tab normally moves focus to the next control.

blocks.code:
from urllib.parse import quote
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By

driver = webdriver.Chrome()
try:
    driver.get("data:text/html;charset=utf-8," + quote('<input id="first"><input id="second">'))
    from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
    first = driver.find_element(By.ID, "first")
    first.click()
    first.send_keys(Keys.TAB)
    assert driver.switch_to.active_element.get_attribute("id") == "second"
finally:
    driver.quit()
blocks.title: Press a keyboard key

blocks.text: Focus moves to the second input.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A keyboard test should check the focused element, not just send a key.
